Cookies and storage

Last updated November 10, 2026

Your choice

We block Google Analytics until you select Accept. Reject non-essential keeps it off. Use Cookie settings in the footer to change your choice. We apply this default worldwide. Rejecting analytics does not disable the atlas, contact form, videos or planner.

Essential browser storage

fishing-atlas.plan.v1 holds your saved plan until you clear site data. castward.analytics-consent.v1 holds your consent choice and date for up to 180 days. These values are stored locally, not used as advertising identifiers. Older versions may have stored fishing-atlas.events.v1 and fishing-atlas.attribution.v1; rejection removes these old values.

Optional analytics cookies

After acceptance, Google Analytics may set _ga and _ga_4NYGJ2BF32 to distinguish visits and sessions. We configure a 180-day cookie lifetime, which can renew on activity. Google Analytics processes usage data as described in our privacy policy. We deny ad storage, ad user data and ad personalization. We use no advertising cookies in this implementation.

Remove or change storage

Reject analytics to stop our events and delete accessible analytics cookies. Your browser settings can remove all Castward cookies and local storage; this also deletes saved plans and your consent choice. Blocking all storage can prevent plan persistence. Global Privacy Control selects rejection on page load. Third-party sites reached through links control their own storage.
